UKHC010176552026
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition Service Single No. 2558 of 2026
29th October 2026
Mahesh Chandra Pant --Petitioner
Versus
State Of Uttarakhand 
2: Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection 
Commission
3: Controller Of Examinations --Respondent
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Presence:-
Mr. Vinay Kumar, learned counsel with Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned 
counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. P.C. Bisht, learned Chief Standing Counsel for the State.
Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for UKSSSC.
----------------------------------------------------------------------
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
1. A serious issue has been cropped-up after 
examining the entire record and after gone through with 
the Act and the Rules there is complete deviation by the 
recruiting agency in respect of ongoing selection. This is 
really very shocking and surprising.
The UKSSSC was established in the year 2014 
pursuant to the Notification dated 24.06.2014 issued by 
invoking Article 200 of the Constitution of India.
Chapter III of this Notification deals with powers 
and duties of the Commission and allocation of business.
Chapter IV deals with notification of vacancies and 
appointment.
Rule 18 of Chapter IV pertains to selection by the 
Commission which read as under:-
18 (1) The Commission shall, as soon as 
possible after the intimation of vacancies under section 
17, hold examination or interview or both and prepare in 
the manner prescribed a list of the candidates who are 
found suitable;
1 UKHC010176552026
(2) The list referred to in sub-section (1) 
shall be forwarded to the appointing authority and the 
appointing authority shall make appointment from the list 
so forwarded to it in the order mentioned therein.
2. Thereafter after approval of the Government by 
letter dated 08.06.2015, regulations were framed in the 
year of 2015. Rule 9 of 2015 Regulations deals with
scrutiny of application.
Rule 11 deals with qualification which reads as 
under:-
11. Candidate Qualifications: The criteria for 
qualifications will be as follows:
(1) An application shall be rejected if the candidate 
has not filled it out properly, left columns blank, 
failed to sign the declaration at the end, not 
remitted the requisite fee, omitted necessary details 
(such as academic, technical, or professional 
qualifications), defaced the application form, failed 
to affix self-attested/self-signed photographs, 
submitted the application after the prescribed 
deadline, or failed to meet additional requirements. 
Regarding the reservation category and sub￾category, the candidate must indicate these in the 
appropriate columns of the application form, failure 
to do so shall result in the candidate being treated 
as a General category candidate, provided the fee 
applicable to the General category has been paid 
otherwise, the application will be rejected due to the 
non-receipt of the full fee.
(2) Applications containing errors shall be submitted 
to the Secretary of the Commission for rejection.
(3) To obtain a photocopy of a rejected application 
form, the candidate is required to apply using the 
prescribed format and pay the stipulated fee, upon 
receipt of the application, the original form will be 
retrieved, and a photocopy along with the reason 
for rejection shall be provided to the candidate 
against an acknowledgment.
(4) No interim correspondence regarding the 
application shall be entertained or accepted, 
furthermore, no additional documents, photographs, 
drafts, etc., will be accepted after the application 
form has been received.
(5) Information regarding the examination admit 
2 UKHC010176552026
card, etc., shall be sent to the candidate via 
"Certificate of Posting," and the Commission shall 
not be held liable for any postal delays or non￾receipt of the letter. Additionally, admit cards for 
the examination shall be uploaded to the 
Commission's website, enabling candidates to 
download and print a copy if they do not receive the 
postal copy.
(6) The standard of the examination, syllabus, 
minimum educational qualifications, etc., for any 
post shall be in accordance with the 'Uttarakhand 
(Direct Recruitment to Group-C Posts outside the 
purview of the Uttarakhand Public Service 
Commission) Procedure Rules, 2008, issued by the 
Personnel Section-2, Government of Uttarakhand. 
vide Notification No. 798/XXX(2)/08-3(1)/2008 
dated October 1, 2008. In cases where the 
examination syllabus differs, the Commission shall 
determine the syllabus with the prior approval of 
the State Government. For the information of 
candidates, the Commission's decision regarding 
the syllabus shall be specified in the advertisement 
and shall be deemed final.
3. Rule 13 deals with selection process which reads as 
under:
The following procedure will be adopted for 
selection: After scrutinizing the applications, the 
Commission shall decide on the selection process 
specifically, whether to conduct a preliminary 
examination followed by a written examination, or a 
direct written examination. The examination shall 
be conducted in accordance with the instructions 
laid down in the Government of Uttarakhand, 
Personnel Section-2 Order No. 798/XXX(2)/08-
3(1)/2008, dated October 1, 2008.
Thus Rule 13 clearly provides that examination 
shall be conducted in accordance with the instructions 
laid down as per the Notification of Karmik dated 
01.10.2008, i.e., The Uttarakhand Procedure for Direct 
Recruitment for Group ‘C’ Post (Outside the Purview of 
the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission) Rules 2008. 
4. The Notification dated 01.10.2008 deals with the 
3 UKHC010176552026
procedure for direct recruitment and Rule 8 pertains to 
publication and display of correct answers and the marks 
obtained by the candidates which read as under:-
8(1) When the Selection process is complete and 
the select list has been forwarded to the appointing 
authority , the aggregate of marks obtained by the 
selected candidate in the test for selection and in 
the typewriting shorthand and typewriting test and 
practical examination for the post related to 
technical subject, shall be punished in the daily 
newspaper having wide circulation and displayed 
on the Uttarakhand website www.ua.nic.in and on 
the notice board of the district office of the District 
and the concerned office.
(2) The aggregate of marks obtained by all the 
candidates (in the written examination, marks to 
the retrenched employee and in the typewriting or 
shorthand and typewriting and practical 
examination for the post related to technical subject, 
as the case may be categorywise) shall be 
displayed on the Uttarakhand website 
www.ua.nic.in in descending order.
5. Now in the present matter, the final select list was 
published by the UKSSSC in its official website 
www.sssc.uk,gov.in on 16.09.2026.
As informed by the learned counsel for the 
Commission that after publication of select list in the 
Commission’s website, the select list was forwarded to 
the Government on 24.09.2026. In addition to this, 
learned counsel for the petitioner placed before this 
Court another select list which was also published by the 
Secretary of the Commission on 14.10.2026 in the 
Commission’s website, i.e., www.sssc.uk.gov.in . The 
copy of which is placed on record.
6. Learned counsel for the Commission on instructions 
submits that the subsequent select list has yet not been 
forwarded to the Appointing Authority/Government. 
4 UKHC010176552026
7. A specific question is asked from the learned 
counsel for the Commission under which provision of law 
the Commission published the select list in the 
Commission’s website but there is no answer to this.
8. On perusal of Regulation 2015 particularly 
Regulation 13, the Commission should follow the 
procedure as laid down in the Notification dated 
01.10.2008.
Now, as per Regulation 8 of the Notification dated 
01.10.2008, it reveals that the Commission has no power 
to publish select list in it’s official website and after 
selection process is complete, the Commission has to 
forward the select list to the appointing authority and in 
turn the appointing authority shall publish the list in the 
Uttarakhand website, i.e., www.ua.nic.in .
9. The question is how the Commission without 
forwarding the select list to the Appointing Authority 
published the select list in its official website. It is settled 
principle of law that no right is accrued in favour of any 
candidate until and unless the appointing authority 
accept and approve the recommendation made by the 
Commission. Therefore, for what purpose these lists were 
published.
10. In so many matters this Court has observed that the 
procedure as adopted by the Commission appears to be 
faulty and there is a complete deviation of the procedure 
as prescribed.
11. Mr. P.C. Bisht, learned CSC in order to assist this 
Court submit a complete compilation of the Act and 
5 UKHC010176552026
Rules and after gone through with the same, this Court is 
of the view that the UKSSSC in complete violation of the 
Act and Rules proceeded with the selection and 
completely failed to maintain secrecy in the selection. If 
the Commission adopted a faulty procedure that too 
relates to the recruitment, such a faulty procedure 
cannot be accepted, and, therefore, the responsibility 
should be fixed upon the Commission why and for what 
purpose this faulty procedure has been adopted.
Earlier in Writ Petition No. 1448 of 2014 (S/S) this 
Court in respect of another selection framed certain 
questions so that Commission may give answer to this 
and it has been apprised that the matter has not been 
decided so far, therefore, this Court wants to know what 
was the response of the Commission to the question 
framed earlier in the aforesaid petition.
12. List this matter on 30.10.2026 so that the 
Commission may address on the issue.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
Parul
